description: Defines an API endpoint for creating a new catalog item within the eShopOnWeb project. Implements the logic for handling HTTP POST requests to add catalog items, including validation for duplicates, creating new entries, and returning the created item details.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class for creating catalog items, handling HTTP POST requests, and performing validation, creation, and response generation.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the route for the POST request to create catalog items, including authorization and response types.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the creation logic of a new catalog item, including duplicate check, creation, updating the picture URI, and returning the response.
